name: GCP IAM — Service Accounts
description: Pull GCP service accounts as cloud machine identities for CIEM analysis

steps.instruction: Open GCP Console → IAM & Admin → Service Accounts
Create a new service account (or select an existing one) and grant the 'IAM Viewer' role at the project level
Click the service account → Keys → Add Key → Create new key → JSON, then open the downloaded file
Copy the value of 'private_key' (the full PEM block including headers)

validation_request.error_message: Could not connect to GCP IAM. Verify the service account has the IAM Viewer role on the project.

transform.expr: {'cloud_provider': 'gcp', 'identity_type': 'service_account', 'email': record.get('email', ''), 'unique_id': record.get('uniqueId', ''), 'name': record.get('name', ''), 'project_id': record.get('projectId', ''), 'display_name': record.get('displayName') or record.get('email', '')}

{'cloud_provider': 'gcp', 'resource_type': 'service_account', 'identity_subtype': 'machine_identity', 'display_name': record.get('displayName', ''), 'description': record.get('description', ''), 'oauth2_client_id': record.get('oauth2ClientId', ''), 'disabled': record.get('disabled', False), 'project_id': record.get('projectId', ''), 'etag': record.get('etag', '')}
